POST /always_on/{id}/restart/ is listed, but is not a substitute for proved quiescence.
Scheduled tasks have list/read and enabled modification endpoints.
provider_api.inference: PATCH only enabled=false followed by exact GET, and later enabled=true followed by exact GET, offers a documented route for bounded configuration disable/re-enable without replacing command or ID. documentation_limits: No documented guarantee in the inspected API reference that enabled=false synchronously drains descendants or application in-flight work.
No documented complete process membership/drain endpoint or graceful-stop proof.
No documented compare-and-swap/idempotency generation for enabled transitions; exact pre/post config observations and durable one-operation reconciliation are needed.
Positive enabled readback is necessary but insufficient to assert complete writer exclusion.
